notes.title: Walking Zombie is Stationary shooter!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just wanted to make sure that you, potential buyer, are aware that you cannot move in The Walking Zombie other than look around. It is stationary shooter and it seems that some players buy it not knowing this fact (and they are surprised - not in a good way). 

We are sorry that some players buy this game and leave it with disappointment. We tried to make sure that this feature (or lack of feature :-D ) is obvious - from video and description. We didn't intend to deceive anyone. 

We believe that Walking Zombie has many other great features - many environments, tons of enemies and weapons, cool boss fights, funny physics with destroying enemy bodies.


We definitely hope that this game will bring much more fun than disappointment!

notes.title: Information about PC version of Walking Zombie
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we just wanted to let you know about few things concerning PC version of Walking Zombie. First of all, we will [b]release the game on January 19, 2018[/b]. We need some more time to make sure that game on PC will be as good as possible.

[h1]Better graphics[/h1]
One of the biggest changes to PC version is its graphics. Proper lights, proper shadows, ambient occlusion or bloom. These are only a few of the things we can afford on PC and not on mobile. We added new screenshots so you can see improvements for yourself. And we also prepared two gifs with the comparison:
  
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31150212/73755aa6f78a0c90b03edaa57b9885238bb802ea.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31150212/50fd5a338d1200fc824e8cfcd5790e5248e000bd.gif[/img]

[h1]No microtransactions[/h1]
We know that that the microtransactions in the PC game are a bad thing (if that game isn't free-to-play at least) and we removed them from our previous successful port of the mobile game, Defend Your Life. And we are doing it again.

[h1]Multiplayer[/h1]
We added multiplayer to the mobile version too, but it was in one of the recent updates so we need some more time to test it in PC version too. Walking Zombie features singleplayer and multiplayer for 2 players who fight hordes of zombies together.

[h1]What about price?[/h1]
We believe that Walking Zombie brings a lot of arcade fun, but we also know that it is still what it is - rather smaller game and our side project, so we wanted to make sure that we set the corresponding price. Upon release, it should cost less than 2 dollars.
